stars.why: Giannis is probable with right groin tendinitis and played 36 minutes on Wednesday after missing Sunday, so the groin did not limit him. New York is still without OG Anunoby, who is doubtful, and the Knicks no longer have Mitchell Robinson to throw at him.

Towns is off the injury report after the knee inflammation that cost him a game last week, and he played 33 minutes on Wednesday. Anunoby is doubtful and backup center Andre Drummond is questionable after taking a hit to the head on Wednesday, so the frontcourt minutes run through Towns.

stars.note: More minutes with RJ Barrett and Kawhi Leonard out: he played 37.5 minutes a game in the 2 games without them this season.
stars.why: Barnes is the clear lead option again with Kawhi Leonard and RJ Barrett both out; Leonard has only just started individual on-court work. He played 38 minutes in Toronto's last game.

Tatum played 37 minutes on Monday and Boston gets an Atlanta team missing CJ McCollum, Jock Landale, Mouhamed Gueye and Asa Newell. Mitchell Robinson is questionable with an illness, which could put more of the frontcourt load on Neemias Queta.

Brunson played 36 minutes on Wednesday and stays the one sure thing in a Knicks lineup with OG Anunoby doubtful and Jordan Clarkson and Miles McBride questionable. Fewer healthy guards behind him means more of the ball handling stays with him.

scrubs.note: More minutes with Cameron Boozer and Jerami Grant out: he played 25.3 minutes a game in the 3 games without them this season.
scrubs.why: Hendricks has played 24 to 27 minutes off the bench in the three games without Cameron Boozer, though his production has been thin. Zach Edey is questionable after sitting the second half on Wednesday with ankle soreness, and Memphis started Hendricks the last time Edey missed a game.
Kispert played 19 minutes off the bench in Atlanta's last game. CJ McCollum is out with a left calf strain, which opens more wing minutes behind the starters.

scrubs.note: More minutes with Cade Cunningham and Duncan Robinson out: he played 31.0 minutes a game in the 2 games without them this season.
scrubs.why: Green played 27 minutes off the bench on Monday with Cade Cunningham and Duncan Robinson out. Cunningham is out again with knee tendinopathy and Robinson with a quad strain, so the wing minutes are still open.
Dort played 31 minutes off the bench in Atlanta's last game. CJ McCollum, Jock Landale and Mouhamed Gueye are all out, so Atlanta's rotation is short and Dort's minutes should hold.

scrubs.note: More minutes with Cade Cunningham and Duncan Robinson out: he played 17.0 minutes a game in the 1 game without them this season.
scrubs.why: Holland played 17 minutes on Monday without Cade Cunningham and Duncan Robinson. Both are out again Friday, along with Jalen Duren, so Detroit is short on wings.

scrubs.note: More minutes with Cameron Boozer and Jerami Grant out: he played 20.3 minutes a game in the 3 games without them this season.
scrubs.why: Prosper has played 19 to 23 minutes off the bench in Memphis's last three games with Cameron Boozer and Jerami Grant out. Both are out again, and Edey and Isaiah Stewart are questionable, so the Memphis frontcourt is thin.

scrubs.note: More minutes with Jaylen Brown out: he played 31.7 minutes a game in the 3 games without him this season.
scrubs.why: Jaylen Brown is out after leaving Wednesday's game at halftime with left hamstring tightness, and Simons averaged about 32 minutes in the three earlier games Brown missed. He played only 15 minutes on Wednesday, so the bump depends on Nick Nurse going back to him. His game has a 230.5-point total.
Wells has started every recent game for Memphis and played 27 minutes on Wednesday after a 20-minute night on Monday. Boozer, Grant and Scotty Pippen Jr. are all out again.

guide: Pair two or three stars with two or three scrubs, then fill the middle. The scrubs are what make the stars fit under the $50,000 cap.
